design_gotchas.title: CRITICAL: Pin 5 (EN) Abs Max Is ONLY 8.0 V — Direct 12 V VIN Tie Destroys AP62300WU-7
design_gotchas.detail: While VIN tolerates 18 V operating (20 V DC / 22 V 400 ms abs max), Pin 5 (EN) is capped at 8.0 V abs max (p.4). Dropping AP62300WU-7 onto a pin-identical TPS563201/TPS563208 board where EN is tied directly to 12 V VIN destroys the IC immediately. Leave EN floating to auto-start or use a resistive UVLO divider keeping VEN < 6 V.

design_gotchas.title: Pin-Identical to TPS54302/TPS563201/AP62200WU-7 — MISMATCH With AP63300WU-7 & Own SOT563 Z6
design_gotchas.detail: AP62300WU-7 (TSOT26 marking 'HF': 1=GND, 2=SW, 3=VIN, 4=FB, 5=EN, 6=BST) matches TPS563201DDCR, TPS563208DDCR, TPS54302DDCR, and 2 A AP62200WU-7, but is COMPLETELY incompatible with Diodes' own 32 V AP63300WU-7/AP63203WU-7 (1=FB, 2=EN, 3=VIN, 4=GND, 5=SW, 6=BST) AND with AP62300Z6-7 (SOT563 swaps Pins 1/3 and 4/6, p.1).

design_gotchas.title: 0.800 V VREF Causes +34.2% Overvoltage on TPS54302 Dividers & +4.2% Shift on TPS56320x
design_gotchas.detail: AP62300WU-7 regulates FB at 0.800 V ±1% (p.5), whereas TPS54302 uses 0.596 V (+34.2% overvoltage: 3.3 V jumps to 4.43 V!) and TPS563201/563208 use 0.768 V (+4.2% shift). Even inside this datasheet, AP62300TWU-7 (marking 'TP') uses 0.763 V specifically to approximate TI's 0.768 V dividers—always lock exact OPNs and recalculate R1/R2.

design_gotchas.title: High-Speed 750 kHz COT Bootstrap Upsizing (100–330 nF) & 2 oz Cu Thermal Derating at 3 A
design_gotchas.detail: Table 1 (p.17) specifies 100–330 nF C6 bootstrap capacitance for 3.3–5.0 V outputs (plus optional 10–100 pF feedforward C5) and 3.3 uH inductors. Also note the 70 °C/W TSOT26 θJA assumes 2 oz copper (p.4, p.19); on 1 oz boards at TA > 60 °C, check Fig. 41 (p.16) thermal derating at 3 A continuous.

typical_use_cases: 5 V and 12 V bus step-down to 1.2 V, 1.8 V, 3.3 V, or 5.0 V at up to 3 A continuous with low radiated EMI
Pin-compatible 3 A upgrade over 2 A AP62200WU-7 (same TSOT26 pinout, 0.800 V VREF, 750 kHz, 75/45 mOhm FETs)
High light-load efficiency (83% at 5 mA, 155 uA PFM Iq) point-of-load supply for routers, TVs, and smart appliances
Second-source candidate for 12 V TPS563201DDCR rails (after recalculating R1/R2 for 0.800 V and verifying VEN <= 8 V)
engineering_summary: The Diodes Incorporated AP62300WU-7 is a 4.2 V to 18 V input (20 V DC / 22 V 400 ms abs max), 3 A continuous synchronous Constant On-Time (COT) buck converter in TSOT-23-6 (TSOT26, θJA = 70 °C/W on 2 oz Cu) integrating 75/45 mOhm MOSFETs, 750 kHz switching, 155 uA PFM Iq (~83% efficiency at 5 mA, ~94% peak at 12 V->5 V), and ringing-free EMI gate drive. It shares the TSOT26 pinout of 2 A AP62200WU-7 and TI TPS563201/TPS54302 (NOT AP63300WU-7 or SOT563 AP62300Z6-7), but engineers must guard against its strict 8.0 V EN abs max (float to auto-start) and 0.800 V VREF (+34.2% overvoltage on 0.596 V dividers).

300 DPI PNG Vision on p.2 confirmed Fig. 2 AP62300/AP62300T efficiency peaking ~94% at 12 V->5 V (~92% at 3.3 V; ~83% at 5 mA) vs Fig. 3 PWM-only AP62301.
